mappings.reasoning: Product reference uniquely identifies each sellable variant.
English title matches the core model's preference for English names.
French title duplicates title_en, which already feeds name.
Brand name maps directly to brand.
Collection groups products, but values like FW26 look like seasons rather than categories.
Material composition describes the product's materials.
Colour codes need expanding to names; meanings guessed from French initials.
Size label holds the size of each variant.
